description: Two-tier scenario delivering the Gitea docker-compose stack on admin-gitea-standalone (VMID 1183, IP 192.168.142.183, vmbr142) via the shared bundle bundles/admin/software.install.gitea/, against the catalog element range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/gitea/. Gitea is modeled as an admin-tier service gated by INSTALL_GITEA (default YES - gitea_lab is the Gitea showcase scenario). The student-gitea-client-01 VM (VMID 1184, IP 192.168.142.184, vmbr142) is an Ubuntu LTS client running the end-to-end SSH-cycle validation against the Gitea server. Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is built by this scenario's 01_templates-bootstrap/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario such as blank_scenario_2_subnets, demo_lab, misp_lab, nextcloud_lab, or mattermost_lab).
